t: Titan 40-grit 125mm sanding discs are designed for rapid, coarse material removal with random orbital sanders. The robust 40 grit abrasive delivers high performance during dry sanding applications. Ideal for trade professionals and decorators when preparing rough timber, stripping paint, or smoothing down tough plaster and filler before refinishing. Flexible C-weight semi-latex paper backing provides strength and flexibility, and a hook and loop design to ensure fast, secure attachment and easy disc changes. The pre-punched 8-hole configuration improves dust extraction, which also reduces clogging, extends sheet life and provides a cleaner working environment. Contains 5 discs.
b: Compatible with Orbital & Random Orbital Sanders
Suitable for Sanding Wood, Paint & Plaster
Minimises Clogging & Heat for Longer Disc Life
Punched Design Promotes Clean Working Environments
